segments.text: Last week, I tried a small experiment. I gave myself ten minutes to explain a project without looking at my notes.
And, um, the first take was rough. I kept circling back to the same point instead of moving the story forward.
On the second take, I gave myself a simpler structure: what changed, why it mattered, and what I would do next.
That made the whole talk easier to follow. So, if you remember one thing, give your audience a clear path through the story.
